query:
UPDATE encounters
        SET status = CASE WHEN $2 THEN 'sparked' ELSE 'fizzled' END,
            similarity = $3,
            score = $4,
            mode = $5,
            shared_interests = $6,
            reason = $7,
            icebreaker = $8,
            sparked_at = CASE WHEN $2 THEN now() END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
